name: Alpine ibex
desc: A steep-ground grazer living mostly between 1,800 and 3,300 m. It was nearly wiped out by hunting and has been restored by reintroductions.
about: The Alpine ibex, also known as the steinbock, is a European species of goat which lives in the Alps. It is one of ten species in the genus Capra, and its closest living relative is the Iberian ibex.
